notas: Copyright and trademark lawsuit filed in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:24-cv-07984). On 2025-08-21 the court denied Perplexity's motion to dismiss. The source refers to Perplexity's own and third-party web crawlers; crawler name to be confirmed.

Lawsuit filed in San Francisco Superior Court (California). Reddit alleges Anthropic's automated bots kept accessing the site after being asked not to, and trained Claude on users' data without consent. Bot names not given in the source; to be confirmed.

Default storefront robots.txt says buy-for-me agents must not complete payment without a final review step, and points integrators to Checkout Kit. A Shopify engineer said the change "doesn't add or remove any rules": it is a comment, not an enforced rule.

First reported by The Information on 2025-07-30; Amazon did not comment. This article does not name the agents: per Search Engine Journal, Amazon's robots.txt still fully disallows GoogleAgent-Mariner and GoogleAgent-Shopping as of 2026-09-22. Agent type "nube" is based on TechCrunch (May 2025): Google moved Project Mariner to cloud virtual machines on 2025-05-20 (https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/20/google-rolls-out-project-mariner-its-web-browsing-ai-agent/). The type of GoogleAgent-Shopping is unknown.

Cloudflare de-listed Perplexity as a verified bot and added managed rules that block its stealth crawling. Cloudflare is a network provider: the block applies to its customers' sites, including free plans. Perplexity used undeclared user agents and IPs to evade no-crawl directives.
Copyright and trademark lawsuit filed in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:25-cv-07546). Alleges PerplexityBot scrapes the sites for Perplexity's answer engine and at times ignored or evaded robots.txt.

Partnership announced by Walmart: customers and Sam's Club members will be able to shop Walmart through ChatGPT using Instant Checkout. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Launch date to be confirmed (announced as "soon"). Agent type to be confirmed.

Lawsuit in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:25-cv-08736) against Perplexity AI and the scraping and proxy firms SerpApi, Oxylabs and AWMProxy. Cause listed as DMCA section 1201 (circumvention). The docket does not say how Perplexity accessed Reddit; agent name and type to be confirmed.

Copyright lawsuit; court to be confirmed. The Times says Perplexity uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to crawl the web and deliver Times content, including paywalled articles, to its users in real time, after repeated requests to stop. Agent name and type to be confirmed.

Instacart app launched inside ChatGPT, with checkout in ChatGPT built on the Agentic Commerce Protocol (payments via Stripe). Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Agent type to be confirmed.

Partnership announced by Walmart: a Walmart and Sam's Club shopping experience inside Gemini, built on the Universal Commerce Protocol, launching first in the U.S. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Launch date to be confirmed. Agent type to be confirmed.

Effective date of the updated User Agreement (posted 2026-01-20). Bans "buy-for-me agents, LLM-driven bots, or any end-to-end flow that attempts to place orders without human review" unless eBay gives prior express permission. Per Ars Technica, eBay had already added a "Robot & Agent Policy" to its robots.txt in December 2025: https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/01/ebay-bans-illicit-automated-shopping-amid-rapid-rise-of-ai-agents/

Amazon sued in November 2025 under the CFAA and CDAFA; the district court granted a preliminary injunction in March 2026 (exact day to be confirmed). Comet runs locally on the user's machine. The Ninth Circuit vacated the injunction on 2026-08-04.

Alibaba connected its own Qwen App to the full Taobao and Tmall catalog and added a Qwen-powered shopping assistant inside the Taobao app (China). First-party agent: Alibaba owns both Taobao and Qwen. Taobao is also among the apps that declined Doubao Phone Assistant (see the 2026-10-14 row). Agent type to be confirmed.

Confirmed by an Amazon spokesperson. Enforced with a block notice shown to the agent, not via robots.txt. Users saw: "Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use". Muse runs in a cloud virtual machine with its own browser.

First user report on X; complaints spread on 2026-10-15. A user reported the notice: "Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use". Amazon has not confirmed or commented. Musk replied: "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon". Agent type per xAI: Grok Bot runs on its own cloud computer (https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot, https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/computer-and-apps). Second source: https://finance.yahoo.com/small-business/articles/elon-musk-wants-start-amazon-220000094.html

Applies to all Williams-Sonoma Inc. brands, including Pottery Barn. Customers were emailed the week of the article; effective date to be confirmed. Automated tools must identify themselves. No specific agent named, so it applies to all agent types. The company did not comment.

notas: Apps opted out through Doubao's Screen Automation Execution Protocol (SAEP) permission list. 151 apps declined permission (65 Tencent, 23 Alibaba, 14 Kuaishou, 11 Meituan). The list was announced by Doubao and is updated weekly, so the count may change.

Applies to Walmart and Sam's Club. New Terms for AI Agents, Agent Profiles (launching within a month) and the Walmart Agent Gateway, which uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) and is in beta for companies and developers. Customers approve each purchase or set a spending limit; agents get no payment card data and must not act beyond what the shopper intends. Agents that break the terms will be blocked. Applies to all agent types.
